The structure of ZrCo₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4₁/amd (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 20 atoms (Zr₄Co₁₆) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies two main Co environments: one 9-coordinate Co with 3 Co and 6 Zr neighbors, and a 12-coordinate close-packed-like local arrangement, while Zr is 16-coordinate. The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions, and validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Co-centered polyhedra sharing corners and edges, plus corner- and face-sharing between Co and Zr polyhedra.
